title: Map controls to requirements
summary: A draft guide for connecting controls with the framework requirements they help address.

blocks.text: A clear mapping helps teams explain how their controls address requirements and can make later evidence and readiness reviews easier. The strength and direction of a mapping should be reviewed by the responsible compliance owner.

items: Open the requirement you want to address.
Review the controls available for mapping in your environment.
Select the control or controls that meaningfully address the requirement.
Save the mapping using the approved DRisk workflow.
Check the result and record any gaps or follow-up actions.
